stem.text: Compound Y is a straight chain molecule with formula $\text{C}_n\text{H}_{2n+1}\text{X}$. X is a halogen. The $M_\text{r}$ of Y is 137. The halogen atom is on the second carbon atom in the chain.

items: Y can eliminate HX to form two structurally isomeric alkenes.
Y can eliminate HX to form two geometrically isomeric alkenes.
